text:
Situation: Aprepitant and fosaprepitant dimeglumine are on FDA's shortage list as "To Be Discontinued" with no posted date. Corvale East holds 94 fosaprepitant vials (11.3 days) and 71 aprepitant 80 mg capsules (8.4 days). Corvale General holds 239.93 aprepitant units (26.5 days) and 166.5 fosaprepitant units (18.7 days). Corvale Lakeside holds 27 aprepitant units (16 days).

Why (FDA record): FDA inspection 1292960 of Pharmathen International S.A. (FEI 3009961173) ended 2025-11-21 and was classified OAI, with the classification known to FDA on 2026-02-26. FDA issued a Warning Letter to Pharmathen on 2026-05-27. FDA published Import Alert 66-40 for Pharmathen on 2026-04-23. FDA's shortage list also shows Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC's fosaprepitant dimeglumine injection (NDC 63323-972-10) posted as "To Be Discontinued" on 2026-04-08.

Our position: Current inventory supports limited internal redistribution to protect Corvale East. No alternative supplier is on FDA's shortage list today, and product labels do not identify manufacturing sites for risk assessment.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 70 aprepitant units from Corvale General to Corvale East — requires pharmacy director approval of transfer request.
2. Transfer 3 aprepitant units from Corvale Lakeside to Corvale East — requires pharmacy director approval of transfer request.
3. Evaluate purchase from AVYXA Pharma, LLC — requires buyer execution after site verification.
4. Evaluate purchase from Actavis Pharma, Inc. — requires buyer execution after site verification.
5. Evaluate purchase from Amneal Pharmaceuticals LLC — requires buyer execution after site verification.

Not recommended: Initiate clinical protocol changes or dose substitutions; those decisions rest with treating clinicians and the P&T committee.
